chapterTitle: FBISE Annual Exam Simulator 02 (Unit 11 & 12: Organic Chemistry & Hydrocarbons)
subject: chemistry-10

questions.question: Which variety of coal contains approximately 80% carbon content? (FBISE 2024-II)
questions.explanation: Bituminous coal contains approximately 80% carbon and is the most abundant type of coal used in power generation and coke production.

questions.question: In 1828, Friedrich Wöhler successfully synthesized urea ($NH_2CONH_2$) by heating:
questions.explanation: Wöhler heated the inorganic mineral salt ammonium cyanate ($NH_4CNO$) and obtained the organic compound urea, overthrowing the Vital Force Theory.

questions.question: The functional group characteristic of organic esters that imparts sweet fruity aromas is:
questions.explanation: Esters have the functional group $-COOR$ (alkoxycarbonyl group), which gives fruits and flowers their characteristic fragrances.

questions.question: What is the general molecular formula for the alkyne homologous series?
questions.explanation: Alkynes contain one carbon-carbon triple bond and conform to the general formula $C_nH_{2n-2}$.

questions.question: Which gas is used in oxy-acetylene welding torches to generate temperatures exceeding 3000°C for cutting steel?
questions.explanation: Acetylene ($C_2H_2$) burns in oxygen with an extremely hot flame reaching 3300°C, making it ideal for oxy-acetylene welding and cutting.

questions.question: Which diagnostic reagent is used to confirm unsaturation (double/triple bonds) by discharging reddish-brown color?
questions.explanation: Unsaturated hydrocarbons rapidly add bromine across their multiple bonds, discharging the reddish-brown color of bromine water.

questions.question: What product is obtained when ethene reacts with cold, dilute alkaline $KMnO_4$ in Baeyer's test?
questions.explanation: Baeyer's test oxidizes ethene into 1,2-ethanediol (ethylene glycol), while the purple color of $KMnO_4$ is discharged with formation of brown $MnO_2$.

questions.question: Ethanol is dehydrated to ethene by heating with concentrated sulphuric acid at:
questions.explanation: Excess concentrated $H_2SO_4$ dehydrates ethanol to ethene ($CH_2=CH_2$) at 170°C.

questions.question: How many structural chain isomers exist for butane ($C_4H_{10}$)?
questions.explanation: Butane has 2 isomers: unbranched n-butane and branched isobutane (2-methylpropane).

questions.question: Which of the following compounds is an example of an alicyclic (cycloalkane) hydrocarbon?
questions.explanation: Cyclohexane ($C_6H_{12}$) is a saturated ring hydrocarbon (alicyclic), containing only single carbon-carbon bonds.

questions.question: Incomplete combustion of methane in a limited supply of oxygen generates:

options.A: Carbon monoxide ($CO$), carbon black ($C$), and water

questions.explanation: Limited oxygen leads to incomplete oxidation, generating toxic $CO$, particulate carbon black, and $H_2O$.

questions.question: Which of the following organic compounds is a member of the ketone homologous series?
questions.explanation: Acetone (propanone, $CH_3-CO-CH_3$) has a carbonyl group bonded between two alkyl groups, characterizing it as a ketone.
